name: net.fosa.avatar-texture-optimizer
description: An open-source NDMF tool for VRChat avatars that maps mesh UVs to textures, scales UV islands to a target perceptual quality (MS-SSIM + CIEDE2000 + alpha/normal/grayscale metrics), culls unused UV area, and repacks islands into texture-type-grouped atlases while ignoring unrelated material parameters.
